name: man-kit
description: Quality-first build loop for Claude Code: plan → code → test → review. Bundles man-kit + recommended community plugins so all are addable from one marketplace.

plugins.name: man-kit
plugins.description: Build loop orchestrator. Dispatches each stage to the best available plugin and gates transitions on quality checks.

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: Reference: sandboxed code execution with ~98% context-window savings during the man-kit `code` stage. Original work by Mert Koseoğlu (mksglu/context-mode).

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Reference: ~75% reduction in agent output tokens via caveman-speak compression. Original work by Julius Brussee (JuliusBrussee/caveman).

plugins.name: craftpowers
plugins.description: Reference: ships test-engineer, code-reviewer, secure-reviewer, doc-writer, debugger sub-agents that man-kit dispatches during test/review stages.
